rounds.text: Bharat Wire Ropes Ltd trades at a modest P/E of 18.7 [E1], which sits well below the sector benchmark P/E of 30.11x [E6], offering an attractive entry point for value-oriented investors. The company demonstrates exceptional asset efficiency, delivering a Return on Assets (ROA) of 12.02% that comfortably more than doubles the sector benchmark of 5.54% [E8]. Long-term top-line expansion remains robust, evidenced by a 10-year compounded sales growth rate of 26% and a 5-year compounded sales growth rate of 19% [E14, E15]. Furthermore, the stock trades at a reasonable price-to-book ratio of 1.68x on a book value of ₹ 118 [E2], while currently positioned at only 44% of its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: trailing twelve-month sales have contracted by 5%, 3-year compounded sales growth is flat at 0%, and the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4, E16, E17].
